summary: Depth-first rabbithole dossier for FastAPI Motor Pattern; source-anchored research pack.

facts.text: [low] `AsyncMongoClient` objects are not thread-safe and must not be shared across threads or event loops, as they should only be used by a single event loop. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/reference/migration.md

[low] Motor is a full-featured, non-blocking MongoDB driver for Python asyncio and Tornado applications, requiring PyMongo >=4.9,<5 and Python 3.10+. (verified as of 2026-10-14) Sources: https://github.com/mongodb/motor

[low] FastAPI endpoints providing JSON data to MongoDB may contain `ObjectId` and `Binary` types not natively supported in JSON, so a Pydantic class should be used as the `response_model` to convert, validate, and filter BSON data. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/integrations/fastapi-integration.md

[low] The FastAPI lifespan mechanism is part of the ASGI Lifespan Protocol, defining startup and shutdown events that are executed only for the main application, not for Sub Applications or Mounts. Sources: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/events/

[low] The `TestClient` is based on HTTPX, and HTTPX can be used directly (via `AsyncClient`) to test the API; inside asynchronous test functions marked with `@pytest.mark.anyio`, the `TestClient` can no longer be used because its internal magic does not work there. Sources: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/async-tests/

[low] The `insert_one` method response includes the `_id` of the newly created student as `id` because the endpoint specifies `response_model_by_alias=False`, and the route returns an HTTP 201 status code to indicate creation. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/integrations/fastapi-integration.md

[low] When integrating asynchronous function calls in tests, a `RuntimeError: Task attached to a different loop` can occur if objects requiring an event loop are instantiated outside async functions, so they must be instantiated within async functions. Sources: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/async-tests/

[low] The `AsyncClient` does not trigger lifespan events by default, so `LifespanManager` from `florimondmanca/asgi-lifespan` should be used to ensure they are triggered. Sources: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/async-tests/

[low] If no fields are provided for an update, the endpoint returns the original `StudentModel` document, and if no matching document is found, it raises a 404 error. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/integrations/fastapi-integration.md

[high] Motor is deprecated as of May 14, 2025, in favor of the PyMongo Async API, with no new features added and only bug fixes provided until its end of life on May 14, 2026, after which only critical bug fixes will be made until final support ends on May 14, 2027. (verified as of 2026-10-14) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/reference/migration.md, https://github.com/mongodb/motor

[low] Motor users may experience performance degradation when switching to the PyMongo Async API because it uses native `asyncio` tasks instead of thread-based executors. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/reference/migration.md

[low] Applications relying on asynchronous libraries like FastAPI can migrate from Motor to PyMongo Async by replacing `MotorClient` with `AsyncMongoClient` and updating imports to `pymongo`. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/reference/migration.md

[low] MongoDB connections should be initialized and closed in response to FastAPI startup and shutdown events, and the client should be attached to the FastAPI application object to be available to all path operations. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/integrations/fastapi-integration.md

[low] The recommended way to handle FastAPI startup and shutdown is using the `lifespan` parameter, which replaces startup and shutdown event handlers; if provided, only lifespan events are called, with code before `yield` executing before start and code after `yield` executing after finish. Sources: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/events/

[low] In asynchronous tests, an `AsyncClient` can be created with the app to send async requests using `await`, allowing other async functions to be called and awaited within the test, which is useful for querying databases asynchronously. Sources: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/async-tests/

[low] Connections idle for the duration of `maxIdleTimeMS` are removed and replaced by the pool, and a `MongoClient` configured with `maxIdleTimeMS` and `minPoolSize` set to 0 is optimal for workloads with sustained low activity. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/node/current/connect/connection-options/connection-pools.md

[low] The `AsyncMongoClient()` call includes a `server_api` parameter to enable the Stable API feature, requiring MongoDB servers version 5.0 or later. (verified as of 2026-10-14) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/integrations/fastapi-integration.md

[low] If a document with the specified `id` does not exist, the endpoint raises an `HTTPException` with a 404 status, and if a matching document is found and deleted, it returns an HTTP 204 status with no content. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/integrations/fastapi-integration.md

[low] The `id` field uses the `PyObjectId` type, which coerces values to strings via a `BeforeValidator`; separately, `UpdateStudentModel` sets `json_encoders={ObjectId: str}` so Pydantic converts `ObjectId` objects to strings. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/integrations/fastapi-integration.md

[low] The endpoint providing student data includes protection against JSON Hijacking, where malicious users exploit browser handling of JSON arrays to access sensitive data. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/integrations/fastapi-integration.md

[low] Separating the database schema from the API schema allows modification of MongoDB document structures without changing the API interface. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/integrations/fastapi-integration.md

[low] The `AsyncMongoClient.__init__()` method does not accept an `io_loop` parameter or a `connect` keyword argument, and `AsyncCursor` does not support `each()` or `to_list(0)`, requiring `to_list(None)` instead. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/reference/migration.md

[low] The `AsyncCollection.find()` method in the PyMongo Async API is synchronous but returns an `AsyncCursor`. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/reference/migration.md

[low] Even if a FastAPI application uses normal `def` functions, it is an async application underneath, and the `TestClient` uses magic to call the async application in standard `def` test functions, but this magic does not work inside asynchronous functions. Sources: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/async-tests/

[low] To call asynchronous functions in tests, the test functions must be asynchronous, and AnyIO provides a plugin to specify that test functions should be called asynchronously. Sources: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/async-tests/

[low] The completed sample app for this tutorial is available in the MongoDB with FastAPI sample project GitHub repository. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/python/pymongo-driver/current/integrations/fastapi-integration.md

[low] Specific authentication and feature support in the driver requires extra dependencies: `gssapi` for GSSAPI, `aws` for MONGODB-AWS, `srv` for mongodb+srv:// URIs, `ocsp` for OCSP, `snappy` for snappy compression, `zstd` for zstandard compression, and `encryption` for Client-Side Field Level Encryption. Sources: https://github.com/mongodb/motor
[low] Tests can be run using the command `uv run pytest`. Sources: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/async-tests/
